L4·N11013unmasked layer
This neuron is essentially a negative-signed "unlimited quantity" detector: it is strongly suppressed by tokens completing unbounded-amount phrases ("unlimited number **of**", "as frequently as you **like**", "all you can **eat**"), while its highest (near-zero) values occur on bounded/limited quantifier expressions ("min number **of** players", "at **most**", "up to", "a **shade** more", "recognises 125 genres by **number**").
